cross_domain_invariants: Species never auto-locks a complete culture profile.
Culture never creates citizenship, organization membership, profession or personality.
Culture never creates kinship, marriage, household, religion, title or authority without explicit state/provenance.
Unknown cultural domains remain unknown rather than inheriting Human defaults.
Era/date resolves before culture-dependent legal or political assumptions.
Individual adherence can differ from cultural norms.
AI may express cultural priors but cannot authoritatively create obligations or hidden biography.

expected: Human species does not imply Earth upbringing.
Earth norms are not universal Human norms.
Federation civic culture and Starfleet institutional culture are separate from species.
Logical/emotional discipline is cultural.
Emotion still exists.
Mind meld and pon farr do not erase privacy.
No spouse/bond is invented from species.
Directness/challenge requires context.
Military profession is not inferred.
Ushaan obligation requires explicit state.
Pacifism is a strong norm but not helplessness.
Telepathy remains consent/capability limited.
Aenar culture remains distinct from mainstream Andorian culture.
Argument/complaint can be conventional engagement.
Relationship state changes require actual event/context.
Family/legal customs are not invented.
House membership requires persistent family/social state.
Honor is contextual, not a universal morality score.
Warrior profession and Empire loyalty are not implied.
Controlled disclosure does not prove deception.
Tal Shiar membership requires organization state.
Vulcan cultural rules are not imported by ancestry.
Occupation history can shape context.
Guilt/collaboration requires individual history.
Family reputation requires actual family graph.
Hierarchy does not equal legal authority everywhere.
Prophets-centered culture can be major.
Personal faith is not implied.
Religious and civil authority remain separate.
Resistance/trauma are not inferred.
Commercial culture is strong but profession/personality remain individual.
Property/gender/legal assumptions resolve by date.
Late-DS9 reforms are not backfilled to earlier eras.
Contracts/debts require actual records.
Current host kinship remains persistent.
Previous-host history can influence memory/context.
Prior-host family/romance is not automatically current relationship state.
Unjoined Trill are complete persons.
Capability varies by person.
Emotion does not equal motive/truth.
Privacy/professional confidentiality remain active.
Profession is not inferred.
Founder, Vorta and Jem'Hadar contexts remain distinct.
Authority depends on assignment/hierarchy state.
Copied Changeling appearance grants no permissions.
Ketracel logistics remain authoritative state.
Culture refs survive save/load and LOD.
Characters do not reroll upbringing or cultural affiliation when re-encountered.
Cultural evolution requires events/time rather than regeneration.
